text:
ida: quick thought 
we should add an explainability/audit layer to routing decisions. regulators and some customers want a per-request provenance that shows why a route was chosen (latency, cost, tenant policy, region).
matt: yes. we currently log some reason_codes but it's terse. what shape are you thinking?
ida: two layers: lightweight tracelet on every request (kept short, high-cardinality index) + a full provenance blob stored only for sampled requests or on-demand for legal/ops queries.
sophia: storage & privacy concerns. persisting full blobs for all requests will explode costs and may store PII. need retention, redaction, and access controls.
ida: agreed. defaults: tracelet (always): {route_id, reason_codes[], snapshot_id, decision_sig}. full_blob (sampled/on-demand): {input_prompt_hash, full_policy_eval, probe_candidates, timings, snapshot_chain}. full_blob encrypted at rest and access via RBAC.
matt: how do we link the two? tracelet should contain a pointer id if full_blob exists. also need a signed decision_sig to prove it came from a valid snapshot.
ida: exactly. decision_sig = sign(snapshot_id||decision_digest||timestamp) using KMS-managed key. audit service can verify signatures.
sophia: but signing per-request might be CPU-heavy. can we batch sign digests?
ida: we'll sign a per-minute merkle root of decision_digests. edges send digest, central signer returns signed root. edges can include merkle_proof in tracelet. saves ops.
matt: nice. query surface: ops wants to do "show me all requests in 10m window where runtime filtered route X". need indexes on reason_codes, route_id, tenant_id, snapshot_id.
sophia: retention policy: tracelets keep 90 days, full_blob 30 days by default. legal hold can extend per-tenant. also anonymize prompt text unless explicitly requested by legal.
ida: performance: tracelet should be <512 bytes; merkle proof size small. full_blob size variable but compressed. telemetry: track audit_storage_bytes, sign_latency, tracelet_emit_failures, fetch_on_demand_latency.
matt: security: restrict /audit/fetch endpoints behind internal auth and log all accesses. include an audit-bot that records who fetched what.
ida: add a workflow for customers to request retrieval: create ticket INFRA-5124 "audit-provenance-storage-and-signing". link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-5124
matt: operationally, add a debug flag `include_full_blob=true` for canaries so we can validate completeness. also add `audit.shadow_mode` so edges emit full_blob but central store discards unless flagged.
ida: rollout: shadow-mode 2w, small canary with `include_full_blob=true` for a few tenants, then global tracelet-only. gating: sign_latency < 50ms p95, tracelet_emit_failures < 0.01%.
sophia: one more: redact policy. full_blob must run a redaction pipeline for prompts before storage unless legal whitelists. include redaction version in blob metadata.
matt: sounds good. i'll help draft the RFC with data model, merkle signer flow, access controls, and dashboard mockups. schedule arch sync next Tues.
ida: thanks. audit-bot will post the infra ticket when RFC lands.
audit-bot: noted. ticket logged for access/workflow policies."
